milestones.outcome: The author edits a listed file of a local PR draft in the existing code editor and saves it to the worktree, and the save returns as a successor candidate.
exit_criteria: A saved edit is on disk byte for byte and nothing is staged or committed.
A file changed on disk since it was opened is never overwritten, and a not-editable file refuses with its reason.
The draft offers one refresh with the saved files selected; the previous candidate is retained.
No Qt widget or model performs the write, and the workspace adapter is still read-only.
milestones.boundary: Editing and saving only: no commit, no push and no agent. Needs the local draft's durable candidates from RFC-BPR-0108 first.

milestones.outcome: The author commits the selected files and pushes the draft's branch from the local draft through their own Git, and Create draft PR follows without leaving the application.
exit_criteria: A commit holds exactly the selected files' captured content with the author's identity, signing and hooks, and leaves every other change as it was.
A push reaches the resolved hosted repository by its configured URL with the author's credentials and pre-push hooks, and never forces.
The isolated runner is unchanged, and the own-Git catalogue holds commit and push only.
Declining the one-time question leaves the named commands of RFC-BPR-0111 as the path.
RFC-BPR-0111's live text and BPR-2029 are reconciled with the reopened PUBLISH-01.
milestones.boundary: Reopened PUBLISH-01: BPR commits and pushes on the author's press. No merge, squash, rebase or force push. Needs the native pull request creation of RFC-BPR-0111 first.

milestones.outcome: The author has an agent review their own change under a prompt of its own, fix a note or a finding in the local draft's worktree, keeps or reverts each changed file, and checks the fix.
exit_criteria: A change run starts only on the author's press and under the Edits this worktree grant, never in a pull request review.
The candidate and everything attached to it are unchanged until the author accepts a refresh.
Keep and Revert act per file, and Revert restores exactly the recorded bytes.
Self-review runs read-only under its own editable prompt from Agent settings, separate from the review skill.
Findings become notes on a local draft, and Check the fix shows the agent's answer as a claim.
RFC-BPR-0104's live text is reconciled with the new grant.
milestones.boundary: Fix runs change files and make no commit. Needs the agent grant line of RFC-BPR-0104, the local-draft sessions of RFC-BPR-0110 and the prompt sharing format of RFC-BPR-0107 first.

milestones.outcome: The author has an agent merge the target in, squash or rebase the draft's branch, and BPR reports what it can establish about the result.
exit_criteria: A history run refuses to start on an unclean or mismatched worktree and records the earlier head.
Identical content after a squash keeps notes, evidence and tour attached; changed content is reviewed as a successor candidate.
An incomplete merge or rebase makes no successor candidate; a complete one marks every file changed on both sides.
Rewriting commits observed on the hosted branch stops first, and nothing in BPR force-pushes.
The agent-changes RFC closeout judges every criterion with an installed agent as well as the fixture agent.
milestones.boundary: History operations exist only as agent runs. BPR itself performs none and offers no reset.
